summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q2 2026 and H1 2026 financial results. The filing discloses an 11% adjusted operating profit growth at CER, a DKK 6.3 billion impairment charge on pipeline assets, and a raised full-year 2026 outlook for sales and operating profit. This is a routine earnings report from a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic review, board recommendation, or deal-specific terms are present. The filing highlights product launches and pipeline progress. There is no event meriting classification as a special situation; the appropriate category is 'None'.
